vllm_gemma31b_recipe.applicability: Model-specific starting range; not validated for dual RTX 3090, original GGUF, TQ4 KV, 200k context, or this concurrency. Recipe explicitly recommends hardware-specific experimentation.

vllm_032_generic_mtp_guide.applicability: Generic conservative starting value, not a measured Gemma31B optimum.

google_transformers_example.applicability: Transformers example; not a recommendation to set vLLM MTP depth to 4.

published_mtp_guidance.author_reddit_scope: Author supplies llama.cpp MTP activation flags and first-hand speed/stability claims, explicitly tested only with llama.cpp; no draft-token count is recommended in the release post.
published_mtp_guidance.source_audit_decision: Keep MTP enabled at the existing depth 2. Published values motivate a future controlled depth sweep, not an immediate configuration change or a proven repetition fix.

native_sampling_inheritance.endpoint_evidence: Root and backend_qat verified the captured native-worker wire requests and replay_captured.py:108 use the OpenAI chat-completions endpoint. The separate earlier Anthropic incident is not this ablation.
native_sampling_inheritance.verification_method: Read-only installed-source trace; no runtime request or GPU validation.
trace: Captured native-worker requests use ChatCompletionRequest directly; omitted top_k/min_p/repetition_penalty fields default to None.
ModelConfig.get_diff_sampling_param merges override_generation_config and retains all five sampling fields.
ChatCompletionRequest.to_sampling_params resolves each field by explicit request, then server default, then neutral default.
The V2 rejection sampler processes target logits through the regular sampler, including native repetition penalty, temperature, min_p and top-k/top-p.
native_sampling_inheritance.seed_propagation: ChatCompletionRequest.to_sampling_params forwards self.seed to SamplingParams. Backend_qat confirmed paired actual-request fixtures add seed 17 identically; the short speed fixture uses seed 20261023.

installed_tq_mtp_depth_dispatch.verification_method: Read-only installed-source trace; performance consequence not measured here.
installed_tq_mtp_depth_dispatch.target_verification_query_length: num_speculative_tokens + 1 when the full draft sequence is scheduled
installed_tq_mtp_depth_dispatch.prefill_like_condition: max_query_len > 4 (or num_tokens > 4 * num_seqs when max_query_len is absent)
installed_tq_mtp_depth_dispatch.mixed_batch_scope: A prefill with query length above 4 selects the 2D path for the whole unified TQ batch, including shorter MTP verification requests. Native protected layers have their own attention dispatch.
installed_tq_mtp_depth_dispatch.future_measurement: Keep MTP on; compare depths 1/2/3 before crossing to 4. Record kernel dispatch, accepted tokens per verification, full mixed-step duration, request inter-token latency and total throughput at actual long contexts. Depth 4 changes both speculative work and TQ attention algorithm, so a speed difference cannot be attributed to drafting depth alone.

evidence_limits: Author MTP speed claim is a llama.cpp measurement, not a vLLM guarantee.
Configured defaults can be overridden by individual requests.
No runtime settings were changed by this source audit.
This verifies author sampling values and installed inheritance/dispatch paths, not the cause of earlier repetition.
No official or author setting found in the checked sources establishes a fix for the aged-process repetition on this exact GGUF/TQ4 stack.
The recipe's historical nightly-only availability note is superseded by Gemma MTP support in the installed v0.32 documentation; it is not an instruction to upgrade.
Keep original weights, context, KV configuration, batching and frozen plugin unchanged during the existing comparison.
